statement: The covariance of the weeks is unstructured; the SAP falls back on a Toeplitz matrix when the unstructured one meets a computational singularity. On these data the unstructured fit reaches its maximum, so the fallback is not met; the machine does not implement it (a fit that fails gives missing results).

statement: The treatments are compared at each week by the Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test of row mean scores, with the CIBIC+ values as scores, controlling for the pooled site group. The SAP names the CMH test controlling for site; the footnote of ad hoc template 1 adds 'Pearson Chi-Square', which can be read two ways. Read as a name of no CMH statistic, the documents are silent and the value is the one under which the CSR's three p-values are reproduced (row mean scores with these scores). Read as the CMH statistic of general association, which for one stratum is (n - 1)/n times Pearson's chi-square, the documents decide (PLAN.md decision 17): gold would be general association (0.478, 0.770 and 0.868 on the pilot), and the CSR's three p-values would be rule_choice differences. The owner decided (2026-11-20, ADR-015), as the person PLAN.md section 4.5 asks, for the first reading, under which the CSR's numbers are reproduced: the documents are silent on the statistic, and the owner supplies row mean scores.
